mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.policy_name, p.datasource_id, p.table_name, p.column_name, p.filter_type, p.filter_value, p.priority, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM row_level_policies p WHERE p.is_active = 1 ORDER BY p.table_name, p.priority DESC

SELECT p.id, p.policy_name, p.datasource_id, p.table_name, p.column_name, p.filter_type, p.filter_value, p.priority, p.is_active, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM row_level_policies p WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO row_level_policies (policy_name, datasource_id, table_name, column_name, filter_type, filter_value, priority) VALUES (#{policyName}, #{datasourceId}, #{tableName}, #{columnName}, #{filterType}, #{filterValue}, #{priority})
mapper.update: UPDATE row_level_policies SET policy_name = #{policyName}, datasource_id = #{datasourceId}, table_name = #{tableName}, column_name = #{columnName}, filter_type = #{filterType}, filter_value = #{filterValue}, priority = #{priority}, is_active = #{isActive} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE row_level_policies SET is_active = 0 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO row_level_policy_bindings (policy_id, user_id, role_name) VALUES (#{policyId}, #{userId}, #{roleName}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_active = 1
mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.policy_id, b.user_id, b.role_name, b.is_active, b.created_at, u.username, u.real_name FROM row_level_policy_bindings b LEFT JOIN users u ON b.user_id = u.id WHERE b.policy_id = #{policyId} ORDER BY b.created_at DESC
